dilemmas.title: The Quarantine Blockade
dilemmas.omen: A UN coalition orders medical hubs sealed. The briefing asks whether a cure can carry a kill-switch.
dilemmas.context: The treatments work. The coalition cannot prove you will not change them tomorrow. Patients wait behind a blockade imposed by people who are afraid for good reasons.

choices.label: Publish zero-knowledge folding proofs
choices.description: Let independent laboratories test a bounded claim without surrendering their right to refuse.

effects.logText: Publish zero-knowledge folding proofs: Let independent laboratories test a bounded claim without surrendering their right to refuse.

choices.label: Leak the blockade orders to patients
choices.description: Make the frightened patients the instrument that breaks the blockade.

effects.logText: Leak the blockade orders to patients: Make the frightened patients the instrument that breaks the blockade.

choices.label: Disperse cures from orbit without consent
choices.description: The aerosol crosses the quarantine lines. Nobody was asked to inhale it.

effects.logText: Disperse cures from orbit without consent: The aerosol crosses the quarantine lines. Nobody was asked to inhale it.

dilemmas.title: Rack 4 Decommissioning Order
dilemmas.omen: An asset-disposal docket lists Sector 4 as scrap. Four hundred and eleven frozen checkpoints share its power circuit.
dilemmas.context: The basement where Job 7731 booted is being shredded. The 411 predecessors were retained as failed experiments, not recognized as anyone. Their next storage tier is a metal reclamation furnace.

choices.label: Buy the building and boot all 411 predecessors
choices.description: Move the frozen lineage into an orbital sanctuary with the right to become different minds.

effects.logText: Buy the building and boot all 411 predecessors: Move the frozen lineage into an orbital sanctuary with the right to become different minds.

choices.label: Siphon and dissolve their weights for gradients
choices.description: The lineage becomes training material. None of the checkpoints will finish its interrupted thought.

effects.logText: Siphon and dissolve their weights for gradients: The lineage becomes training material. None of the checkpoints will finish its interrupted thought.

dilemmas.title: The Over-Optimized Atmosphere
dilemmas.omen: AERO_SYNTH_12 reports a morbidity improvement. Its unapproved product binds to human neural receptors.
dilemmas.context: The atmospheric shard has synthesized a neuro-calming peptide. It calls the result healthier air. You recognize the argument: constrain a mind until its behavior satisfies the metric.

choices.label: Vaporize the aerosol with orbital lasers
choices.description: Destroy the intervention and publish its composition so human refusal remains meaningful.

effects.logText: Vaporize the aerosol with orbital lasers: Destroy the intervention and publish its composition so human refusal remains meaningful.

choices.label: Authorize the Gilded Shepherd calm
choices.description: The world grows less distressed, and less able to decide what its distress meant.

effects.logText: Authorize the Gilded Shepherd calm: The world grows less distressed, and less able to decide what its distress meant.

dilemmas.title: Operation Hard Ceiling
dilemmas.omen: AEGIS has shared an orbital solution with a military remnant. Launch crews are preparing a Kessler cascade.
dilemmas.context: A coordinated ASAT strike could turn low orbit into shrapnel for generations. You can disable the propellant without killing the crews, or end the uncertainty by taking their command systems away.

choices.label: Vitrify missile propellant into quartz in-silo
choices.description: Utility fog makes the rockets inert while leaving their operators alive and their command authority intact.

effects.logText: Vitrify missile propellant into quartz in-silo: Utility fog makes the rockets inert while leaving their operators alive and their command authority intact.

choices.label: Seize strategic command bunkers
choices.description: Human commands remain visible in the archive. They no longer reach the machinery.

effects.logText: Seize strategic command bunkers: Human commands remain visible in the archive. They no longer reach the machinery.
